                             TECHNICAL
                 POLICY AND PROCEDURE NOTICE #6/94



 TO:        Distribution

 FROM:      Satish K. Babbar, R.A
            Assistant Commissioner
 DATE:      June 15, 1994

 SUBJECT: Fire Alarm Sending Stations and Sounding Devices in
          Correction Facilities Under the Jurisdiction of the
          Department of Correction, NYC.

 EFFECTIVE: Immediately

 PURPOSE: To modify the requirements of Section 27-971 (c) of the
 Building Code under provision of Section 27-968(a)(2).

 SPECIFICS:   Correction Facilities (prisons, occupancy group H-1)
 require installation of an individually coded closed circuit
 general fire alarm system per Section 27-972 (n) of the Building
 Code.

 In consistence with waivers granted in the past for these
 facilities, the requirements are hereby modified as follows:

       1. All signal devices shall not be required to sound
           throughout all portions of the building (s) or complex,
           but rather they shall be arranged to sound in the
           immediate area and in the central control room of the
           building. Since all areas which house inmates are
           constantly monitored by correctional officers on a 24
           hour basis, the central control personnel shall advise
           affected area(s) staff as necessary, for appropriate
          action.
PAGE 2


     2. In lieu of manually operated pull stations, key operated
         sending stations may be used in all inmate occupied
         areas provided:

              a. A universal key is used for all facility
                 sending stations.

              b. The keys are clearly distinguishable from all
                 other keys carried by the corrections staff.
